subject: CedarBank RFP: abuse detection evidence & incident reporting playbook
messages:
From: Alice Rivera <alice.rivera@cedarbank.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: security@cedarbank.com
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP: Abuse detection evidence & incident reporting request

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for taking this RFP request — CedarBank is currently evaluating vendors for our customer-facing LLM offering and we need a consolidated evidence package for the abuse-detection and incident reporting portion of the RFP. Specifically we're asking for:

- An evidence matrix mapping product controls to RFP questions (detection types, model access controls, policy enforcement points)
- Example telemetry and the format for forensic exports (NDJSON/CSV), with a 24–72h sample if possible
- Incident reporting SLA (time-to-detect, time-to-notify, escalation path) and runbook excerpts
- Data retention and redaction policy (how PII is handled in logs and exports)
- Interface for automated alerts (webhook/SNMP/CloudWatch) and any RBAC on alert subscriptions

We have an internal deadline to upload the completed security addendum by next Wednesday. Would you be able to provide an initial set of artifacts and a short (30m) security deep-dive next week?

Thanks,
Alice Rivera
Head of Vendor Security — CedarBank
alice.rivera@cedarbank.com

Hi Alice,

Thanks for the clear ask — we can meet your timeline. I am attaching an initial evidence package and a prioritized delivery plan:

Attachments: redwood_evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx (mapping), slo_incident_flow.pdf (summary runbook), logs_sample_20270328.ndjson (24h scrubbed sample)

Short plan:
1) Today: deliver evidence matrix + scrubbed logs sample (attached).
2) Thu 2027-04-01: deliver expanded runbook excerpts and API webhook examples.
3) Next Tue (2027-04-06): 30m security deep-dive to review SLOs, retention, and export format.

A few clarifying questions to make the artifacts useful:

Ben (SE) and Stephanie (Security lead) are on copy for technical detail. Marissa will own material evidence updates.

If that schedule works, we'll finalize the fuller bundle by Thu.

Best,

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 10:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: CedarBank RFP - evidence and export clarifications

Quick internal note before we send Thu deliverables. High-level approach and suggested caveats to include in the materials: 

- Telemetry/export: provide both NDJSON sample (attached) and a summarized CSV with event types (warning/error/blocked/flagged) — some customers only want aggregated alerts. 
- Retention: propose default 90 days for searchable telemetry, 365 days for cold archives (encrypted). Flag PRI/PII fields in the sample and explain redaction pipeline used (deterministic hashing + token masking).
- Alerts/API: include webhook payload example and a signed HMAC header pattern; offer webhook retries + dead-letter to S3.
- Incident SLA: commit to T+2 business hours for high-severity detection acknowledgements and T+24 hours for customer-facing impact notifications; include our escalation ladder and optional dedicated Slack channel for enterprise customers.
- Forensics: provide an option for SFTP push or presigned S3 export; ensure exports are scrubbed of raw model weights/embeddings unless Customer explicitly requests a deeper forensic export under NDA.

Marissa, please review the evidence matrix and confirm the SOC2 & pen-test artifacts references. Ben, can you prepare the webhook example and a short set of curl commands for the Thu deliverable?

Thanks — we'll avoid promising full raw token streams unless CedarBank signs the expanded forensic addendum.

– Steph

Lauren / team —

Received the artifacts and logs sample, thank you. The matrix looks comprehensive at a glance; a few follow-ups before the deep-dive:

- CedarBank requires the option to export raw per-request events (redacted) for up to 90 days for internal investigations. If raw exports would include token-level content we will require an NDA amendment — please call that out.
- The incident SLA you proposed (T+2 detection ack.) is acceptable but we need a customer-facing notification commitment for incidents impacting more than 100 users. Can you confirm T+24 notification will be included in the final addendum?
- Please include the webhook HMAC example in the Thu package and a small sample of the retry/backoff behavior.

We'd like to schedule the 30m security deep-dive on Mon 2027-04-05 at 10:00 AM PT. Please send a calendar invite and preferred dial-in.

Thanks — look forward to the call.

Alice Rivera
Head of Vendor Security — CedarBank
alice.rivera@cedarbank.com
